_about: Parents and guardians: jobs (with min/max standing level), temperament, notable facts, status and family secrets. Original content written for DCUGen.

secrets.text: A parent was once a costumed vigilante, and the old mask is still in a shoebox in the attic.
secrets.hook: Someone from that parent's old rogues gallery has come out of retirement.

secrets.text: The family fortune, such as it is, started with money stolen from a mob boss.
secrets.hook: The mob boss's grandson has done the math.

secrets.text: {name} has a half-sibling the family never mentions.
secrets.hook: The half-sibling has just turned up asking questions.

secrets.text: A grandparent worked for a secret government program that tested chemicals on soldiers.
The family changed its name after testifying against a criminal organization.

complication.text: A criminal syndicate never forgot the family that testified against it.

secrets.text: One parent is not {name}'s biological parent, and everyone except {name} knows it.
The family descends from a line of stage magicians who may not always have been faking it.
A parent once worked as a henchman for a costumed villain and still owes that villain a favor.
secrets.hook: The villain has come to collect the favor.

secrets.text: There is a bank deposit box in another country, and only the eldest child is supposed to learn its number.
A great-aunt was institutionalized for 'hearing the stars talk'. Some of her notebooks survive.
The family farm sits on land with something buried under it that the government quietly fenced off.
A parent covered up a hit-and-run decades ago.
{name} was born in a different country than the paperwork says.
A parent has been in a long, discreet relationship with a powerful politician.
The family has a history of 'odd gifts' that skips a generation, and nobody discusses it at dinner.
A relative is a well-known costumed hero, and the family is sworn to secrecy.
The family business has been laundering money for the same crew for twenty years.
A parent was a scientist whose research was stolen and turned into a weapon.
secrets.hook: The weapon built from that research has just been used in {city}.

secrets.text: An uncle everyone said died in an accident actually vanished into a sealed government facility.
The family's 'heirloom' necklace was looted from a temple, and the temple's guardians have long memories.
A parent was once abducted by something that came down out of the sky, and came back different.
The family owes a ruinous debt to a loan shark who is patient for now.

complication.text: Is quietly paying down a family debt to dangerous people.
